text: They gave them lot four. They hounded them. They chased them all over the mountains. They chased them and hounded them until everything became like a swarm of bees. All the worker bees clinked to the queen. Clink to the queen. Clink to the queen. Bees, bees, clink to the queen. Taste her honey. Tone her quen.
